text.headline: Timeline of Turkey
text.text: Major events in the history of Turkey.

events.headline: Battle of Manzikert
events.text: Seljuk Turks defeat the Byzantines, opening Anatolia to Turkish settlement.

events.headline: Ottoman Empire Founded
events.text: Osman I establishes a principality that becomes a vast empire.

events.headline: Fall of Constantinople
events.text: Mehmed II captures the city, making it the Ottoman capital.

events.headline: Siege of Vienna Fails
events.text: Marks the end of Ottoman expansion into Europe.

events.headline: Ottoman Collapse
events.text: Defeat in WWI leads to partition of Ottoman territories.

events.headline: Republic of Turkey Founded
events.text: Atatürk establishes the republic and becomes its first president.

events.headline: UN Membership
events.text: Turkey becomes a founding member of the United Nations.

events.headline: Military Coup
events.text: A military coup triggers political purges and a new constitution.

events.headline: AKP Rises
events.text: Recep Tayyip Erdoğan’s AKP wins national elections.

events.headline: Republic at 100
events.text: Turkey marks its centennial amid debates over democracy and secularism.
